prompt: Create ONE original raster PNG technical educational diagram for a Korean IT blog. White opaque background, navy readable sans-serif text, flat blue/teal boxes, generous whitespace. Use only the exact subject and components below. No logos, watermark, decorative illustrations, unrelated graphs, extra numeric values or invented facts. Redesign composition rather than copy source. Every connection must be accurate and labels fully readable.  Title Acyclic-graph directories. Original diagram with root entry paths and shared-object table to avoid crossing lines. Root has dict/ and spell/. Left card dict/ entries: list → File A; all → Shared File L; w → Shared Directory D; count → Shared File C. Right card spell/: count → Shared File C; words → Shared Directory D; list → File B. Below centered one Shared Directory D card with entries list → Shared File L; rade → File R; w7 → File W. Single object boxes for Shared File L and Shared File C, repeated references denote same identity. Distinct File A/B have same entry name list but are different files. Exact arrowheads from entry to object; no outgoing edge back to dict/spell/root. Caption Shared objects, no cycles. IDs A/B/C/L/R/W/D illustrative identity labels, not filenames.
